arg.name: configuration_package
arg.description: The ROS package where we find the configuration files.

arg.name: description_file
arg.description: URDF/XACRO description file with the robot.

arg.name: use_mock_hardware
arg.description: Whether to use mock hardware or real hardware.

let.name: robot_description
let.value: $(command '$(find-exec xacro) $(find-pkg-share $(var configuration_package))/config/$(var description_file).urdf.xacro \ use_mock_hardware:=$(var use_mock_hardware) \ robot_ip:=$(var robot_ip)')
